translationRepairs: When the governor of Sichuan, Yusui, was impeached, Zailing was ordered to go and investigate.
When the Sichuan governor-general Yurui was impeached, Zailing was ordered to go and investigate.
s0043 reads 會川督裕瑞被劾: 裕瑞 is Yurui, not Yusui, and 川督 is the Sichuan governor-general. The prior idiomatic errs on both the name and the office; the proposed wording matches the Chinese.
When the Sichuan governor Yusui was impeached, Zailing was ordered to go investigate.
When the Sichuan governor-general Yurui was impeached, Zailing was ordered to go investigate.
The same Chinese 川督裕瑞 requires Yurui and governor-general in the literal field. Replacing Yusui and governor with those forms corrects real errors without changing the rest of the sentence.
Zongshi Fukun, styled Zhenting, belonged to the Bordered Blue Banner and was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Limi, Yunsi.
Zongshi Fukun, styled Zhenting, belonged to the Bordered Blue Banner and was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Limi, Yunreng.
s0092 names 理密親王允礽; 允礽 is Yunreng, not Yunsi. The prior idiomatic misreads the personal name; Yunreng restores the source.
Zongshi Fukun, courtesy name Zhenting, was affiliated with the Bordered Blue Banner and was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Limi, Yunsi.
Zongshi Fukun, courtesy name Zhenting, was affiliated with the Bordered Blue Banner and was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Limi, Yunreng.
Literal likewise must render 允礽 as Yunreng. The proposed replacement fixes only that naming error and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
In the third year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tirean Hall.
In the third year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall.
s0033 has 體仁閣大學士; 體仁閣 is Tiren Hall. Tirean is a misspelling of that hall name, and Tiren matches the Chinese reading.
The following year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tirean Hall.
The following year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall.
s0059 likewise reads 授體仁閣大學士. Correcting Tirean to Tiren restores the proper hall name without other change.
The following year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tirean Hall.
The following year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall.
s0088 again has 體仁閣大學士. Tirean is erroneous; Tiren Hall is the accurate English for 體仁閣.
In the seventeenth year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tirean Hall.
In the seventeenth year he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall.
s0107 reads 十七年，授體仁閣大學士. The hall is Tiren, not Tirean; the proposed fix is complete and natural.
In the twenty-ninth year he served as associate grand secretary and was appointed grand secretary of the Tirean Hall.
In the twenty-ninth year he served as associate grand secretary and was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Hall.
s0143 has 授體仁閣大學士 within the twenty-ninth-year appointments. Replacing Tirean with Tiren corrects the misspelling and preserves the rest of the sentence.

He was ordered, together with Vice Minister Tong Hua, to proceed to Sichuan to investigate the impeachment of Governor Ding Baozhen and others; in their report they recommended that Baozhen be referred to the ministry for deliberation.

He was ordered, together with Vice Minister Tong Hua, to proceed to Sichuan to investigate the impeachment of Governor-General Ding Baozhen and others; in their report they recommended that Baozhen be referred to the ministry for deliberation.
s0076 names 總督丁寶楨; 總督 is governor-general, not governor. The proposed idiomatic change fixes that office title and leaves the investigation report wording unchanged.
He was transferred to be grand secretary of the Heir Apparent's household and through successive promotions reached the post of inner court academician.
He was transferred to be secretary (xima) of the Heir Apparent's household and through successive promotions reached the post of inner court academician.

s0038 reads 遷洗馬，累至內閣學士. 洗馬 is the xima (secretary of the Heir Apparent's household), not a grand secretary; the prior literal invents that rank, and the proposed wording matches the office and the idiomatic rendering.
He was appointed governor-general of Rehe and again requested leave due to illness.
He was appointed lieutenant-general (dutong) of Rehe and again requested leave due to illness.
s0124 has 出為熱河都統. 都統 is a banner lieutenant-general (dutong), not a governor-general (總督). The proposed office title matches the Chinese.
